summary: Iter3 feature-verification for (1) HR Positions CRUD + public /api/positions endpoint and (2) Custom Roles CRUD with permission validation. Backend: new pytest suite test_iter3_positions_roles.py — 12/12 PASS. Regression on iter2 + uploads suites: 34/35 PASS (1 pre-existing pytest-xdist cross-worker fixture flake in test_post_message_with_file_url — not related to iter3). Frontend: /join-us public page correctly fetches /api/positions and shows the admin-created 'Video Editor' card with OPEN badge; HR page /os/hr renders both new Arabic tabs 'الوظائف المفتوحة' (positions list with OPEN/CLOSED + Reopen/Close/Delete) and 'الرتب والصلاحيات' (18 roles including CEO, COO, and custom 'Editor Lead' with permission counts and Edit buttons). CEO login flow works via data-testid selectors. No compile-error banner anywhere.

minor.issue: PATCH accepts the same PositionIn schema as POST — full-body update only, no partial PATCH support. All fields must be resent to change one flag. Consider Optional fields to enable true partial updates.
No uniqueness check on title, so duplicate positions with identical titles can be created back-to-back. Minor UX/data-hygiene concern.
Upsert path allows overwriting a DEFAULT_ROLE (e.g. CEO) permissions — while delete of default is protected, PUT is not. If undesirable, add a guard mirroring DELETE.

issues: Arabic hero heading renders with unusual letter-spacing / visual glyph splitting on desktop (looks like each Arabic word has extra kerning). Verify with an RTL-native reviewer; may be a font-shaping issue vs intentional style.

action_items: (Optional) Support partial PATCH for /api/os/hr/positions/{id} (use Optional[...] fields).
(Optional) Guard PUT /api/os/roles/{name} against overwriting default roles' permissions (currently only DELETE is guarded).
(Optional) Review Arabic hero-text rendering on /join-us — glyphs look overly spaced.
critical_code_review_comments: server_ext.py PositionIn is missing Optional on all fields — PATCH endpoint therefore requires a full body, not a partial patch.
Public /api/positions correctly projects out created_by/created_by_name and _id — no PII leakage confirmed.
Roles PUT (server.py L1064) accepts any role name including reserved defaults; consider symmetric protection with DELETE.
server_ext.py has grown to 750 lines with many concerns (HR/Chat/Files/AI/Reports/Search) — beyond the 700-line guideline; recommend splitting into per-domain routers for maintainability.

success_rate.backend: 100% (12/12 iter3, 34/35 combined iter2+iter3+uploads; the 1 fail is a pre-existing xdist fixture flake)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (join-us, /os login, /os/hr Positions tab, /os/hr Roles tab all render correctly)

seed_data_creation: Tests create/delete their own TEST_ positions and TEST_CustomRole_* roles inline (cleaned up in-suite). Non-admin test user test_emp_<uuid>@example.com is created via /api/os/employees per test module (persistent — consider cleanup fixture later).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter3 positions+roles features work end-to-end. Note server_ext.py POSITION uses full-body PATCH (not partial). Public endpoint is /api/positions (NOT /api/os/positions). For creating non-admin test users, do NOT use *.test or *.local TLDs — email-validator rejects them. Use example.com. All Arabic tab labels: 'الوظائف المفتوحة' (positions), 'الرتب والصلاحيات' (roles). The pytest-xdist cross-worker sharing of pytest.file_video in test_uploads_and_perms.py::test_post_message_with_file_url is flaky — either run with -p no:xdist or refactor to a module-scoped fixture returning the file.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature addition passed acceptance. Minor code-hygiene notes only.
